runbook_fixes.now: update takes --community-name, --admin-label, --footer-text and --admin-icon (four fields, hyphenated flags).
an invalid admin_icon is rejected (admin notice 'Admin menu icon was not changed...', REST 400) and the existing or default icon is kept.
